prompts.char: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG character layer for a compositing/color-matching educational web app. Primary request: one original adult young woman, full body completely visible including shoes, relaxed standing pose, slight three-quarter turn facing viewer, arms relaxed separated slightly from torso. Clean Japanese anime cel animation production art, crisp dark outlines, restrained flat two-tone shading. Short dark blue hair, warm light skin, ivory light jacket over muted teal shirt, rust red skirt, dark ankle boots. Neutral white balanced studio light with no colored environment or dramatic cast shadows. Portrait canvas 1024x1536, centered with 8 percent transparent margin around entire silhouette. True transparent alpha background, no ground, no floor, no cast shadow, no checkerboard drawn into image, no text or lettering, no props, no logos. Bright neutral character deliberately distinct from colored backgrounds for learning color matching. Preserve clean straight RGB colors at anti-aliased alpha edges.
